description: Jasmein Jones was attacked when a man entered her Green Bay, Wisconsin, home with her children present. Since the incident, she's dealt with PTSD and said her family no longer feels safe where they live. She said she's reached out to various organizations for assistance, but hasn't gotten any help. She is now working towards saving up to move to a different residence. Inside Edition Digital has more. To donate to her GoFundMe, visit https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-our-family-heal-and-relocate
title: Green Bay Woman Stabbed 7 Times In Front Of Children
